Senses.Explanation: Within the Caodong Five Ranks, arrival within integration (兼中到) is the fifth named relation. Dongshan’s verse places it outside the opposition of existence and nonexistence; later records repeatedly describe distinctions as exhausted or integrated. Dongshan Liangjie begins the fifth-rank verse by saying it falls into neither existence nor nonexistence. Hongzhi Zhengjue gives it a dawn verse, while an unnamed monastic asks Fenyang Shanzhao for it and receives images of a weaving jade woman and a drumming stone man. Langting Ting uses a returning cuckoo, Juelang Daosheng offers a later black-white diagram, Yongjue Yuanxian says affairs and principle are both gone, and Ruibai Mingxue applies it to a shout after holy and ordinary, subject and object, and existence and nonexistence are exhausted. These remain attributed illustrations of one rank.

Senses.Note: The couplet makes a harsh image of futile calling: even a cry that draws blood cannot make the point, so silence is wiser. Fushi places it after rejecting a verbal distinction about teaching; Falan gives it after an address on speaking and not speaking. Hanyue quotes it while rebuking quick explanations of an old case. Xieyun uses it to end an elaborate comic exchange. “Spring” preserves the poem’s passing-season image; it is not a calendar instruction to stop speaking until summer.

Senses.Explanation: When further lament or explanation cannot help, silence is more fitting. The line is a forceful close to failed or excessive speech. Huiyue uses the verse after urging a listener to relinquish deepening attachments; Poshan applies it to monastic gossip and quarrels. Linye closes a challenge when nobody comes forward; Yinyuan voices it after asking the assembly for a response and receiving none.

Senses.PreferredTarget: It has no wound of its own; do not injure it
AlternateTargets: There is no sore there to begin with, so do not make one
SearchAliases: Vimalakirti do not make a sore
Senses.Note: Tianyin names Vimalakirti as the earlier speaker and asks whether the assembly has itself made a sickness. Guantao applies the warning against dividing people and conditions, Wanru against a contrived seasonal rule, and Tian'an in a direct exchange about positions. ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 王父母必先辭，戒為根本勿輕易，立定諸人成佛基。是恁麼人、聞恁麼說、發恁麼心、受恁麼戒，請出眾來。」時諸子向前作禮，胡跪合掌，師撫尺云：「是事如是持。」便下座。上堂。舉：「福昌重善禪師因僧問：『如何是正法眼？』善云：『夜觀乾象。』僧云：『意旨如何？』善云：『日裏看山。』」師云：「正法眼無處不照燭，只因為物所遮，未免對境麻眯。善老重重點出，便見七通八達。頌曰：『夜觀乾象日觀山，一段光明天地間；剔起眉毛常獨露，廓然照徹透重關。』」五日，上堂。「今朝五月五，景物隨風土；競渡走槐龍，跨門騎艾虎。絲桐騷客吟，村社小兒舞；堪笑衲僧家，就機打口鼓。且道說甚麼？普。」上堂。「當時重善禪師住此福昌，破楹數間、殘僧數輩，晨香夕燈，至於說法如臨千眾，闡化多年，名喧宇宙，古今仰慕。正上座住他者箇保社，家風宛然不異，惟說法不能似他老婆心切，但飯來與眾同喫飯、茶來與眾同喫茶，乃至行住坐臥悉同起倒，不曾與人說箇甚麼？且道：有為人處？無為人處？」乃以手摑口云：「彼自無瘡，勿傷之也。」解夏，上堂。「圓覺為伽藍，青山不曾買，於中坐與行，行坐自端楷。無禪道可參，無識情可擺，從前原未結，今日何須解？結解兩無庸，通身任瀟灑。且道恁麼人畢竟向甚麼處行履？四海五湖中，高聲唱欸乃。」住江陵鶴穴廣嗣禪院。康熙八年八月十五日，師在福昌受請。入院，至三門，云：「此門高廣，龍象總收，或入或出，誰能不由？為甚如此？」以拄杖畫一畫，云：「惟有這些子，不可蹉過。」佛殿。云：「把定時，佛眼覷不見；放開時，且貴大家知。」乃敷坐具，云：「將此身心奉塵剎，是則名為報佛恩。」據室。「手親眼親，頓空四大誰為座？船來陸來，總與一時生按過。」卓拄杖，云：「朝打三千，暮打八百，一下下都盧不錯。」正菴沈護法請開堂。拈帖示眾云：「諸佛宗乘、祖師心印盡從箇裏流出，眾護法文章錦繡亦從箇裏拈來，言中有響、句裏呈機，人天眾前豈可囊藏被蓋？卻請維那對眾宣讀。」指法座，云：「大而無外，高而無尚，百千法門，一音演唱。」喝一喝，遂陞。拈香，云：「此一瓣香，追唐虞而修德，越聲色以化民，端為祝嚴今上皇帝聖躬萬歲，萬歲，萬萬歲！伏願鼓腹謳歌，擊壤之風再見；垂衣端拱，如天之頌重聞。此瓣香，煙霞充其性，文物發其光，奉為滿朝勳貴、本郡尊官、縉紳沈護法，伏願化行俗美郊關靖，雨足風

Senses.Explanation: To awaken the resolve for enlightenment. Zhuanyu Guanheng grades the resolve through the teaching rounds — defiled by holding great-and-small vehicle marks, then cleansed by the emptiness teaching until the full-measure resolve is awakened and the prophecy of buddhahood can follow; Wuyi Yuanlai tells a lay official that to settle the school's affair he must trust cause and effect, know the canon by heart, think on the pain of hell, and awaken the resolve; and Xuzhou Xingsheng, tonsuring two young students, quotes the Pure Name that awakening the resolve is what leaving home means, then rules that keeping precepts, expounding the twelvefold canon or drumming the mouth all fail without it. Muchen Daomin preaches at a rite for the dead that from the buddhas and ancestors down, none crossed the torrent of birth-and-death without awakening the resolve, glossing bodhi as the way so the resolve is a way-mind, Dahui Zonggao defends Zhenxie's urging of it against sneerers — a good teacher who does not urge it had better teach killing and arson — Tianyin Yuanxiu, raising the demon king's vow to wait until the last being is freed, answers that if the king stands inside the beings' realm he has already awakened the resolve, Guantao Daqi has the shout make every arriving being awaken it and reach right awakening, Hanxiu Ruqian displays one sentence so powerful the whole earth, sentient and insentient, awakens the resolve and boards the ferry of prajna, and Xueqiao Yuanxin reads the old-mother buddha's veiled face as mercy: to hawk form as buddha would keep beings forever from awakening the resolve.
